chapter_logline: At Brackenwake, the pair trade a repaired ward engine for medicine and iron, while Sigrid forces Compact marshal Halvor Kest to admit he redirected the weir map to protect the settlement.

identity_contract.SOREN: clearly fictional mature adult; light-brown to dark-blond short-to-medium wavy swept-back hair, never black or bright blond; pale oatmeal quilted work coat under removable quarry leather and iron protection; persistent braced left-leg gait
identity_contract.SIGRID: clearly fictional mature adult; dark-brown to near-black hair in compact low bun or practical braid, never blond or loose red curls; dark blue-brown plaid secured weather cape over removable quarry leather
identity_contract.TAMSIN_REEVE: clearly fictional adult courier-cartographer with practical non-sexualized field clothing and persistent recovering lower-leg injury
identity_contract.HALVOR_KEST: clearly fictional adult Briar Compact marshal; dark iron-brown close-cropped hair with gray temples and short matching beard; practical non-sexualized quarry armor; no real-person reference
identity_contract.BRIAR_COMPACT_WORKER: clearly fictional mature adult settlement workers and defenders in practical work clothing; no real-person reference
